# Python 3.8+, standard library. The embedded data are the exact 135 original nine-integer input rows.
from math import prod
P=1000187
X,Y,Z=(417021,2646,46803)
assert X*X%P==3 and Y*Y%P==7 and Z*Z%P==(147+42*Y)%P
def rev(x):
    assert x%P
    return pow(x%P,-1,P)
def dec(l):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,q=map(int,l.split())
    return ((63*a+63*b*X+63*c*Y+63*d*X*Y+3*e*Z+(-2*f+7*h)*X*Z+3*g*Y*Z+(f-2*h)*X*Y*Z)*rev(63*q))%P
def dot(a,b):return sum(i*j for i,j in zip(a,b))%P
def mul(a,b):return [[dot(r,c) for c in zip(*b)] for r in a]
def vec(n,i):return [int(j==i) for j in range(n)]
def pad(v,n):return v+[0]*(n-len(v))
def lin(k,rows):return [dot(k,c) for c in zip(*rows)]
dat=[dec(l) for l in INPUT.strip().splitlines()];assert len(dat)==135
c0=dat[:15];b0=dat[15:30]
A0=[pad(dat[30+i*(i-1)//2:30+i*(i+1)//2],15) for i in range(15)]
M=[vec(15,i) for i in range(15)];Mi=[v[:] for v in M]
for i,j in [(6,12),(8,9),(10,11),(7,13)]:
    assert c0[i]==c0[j]; B=(b0[i]+b0[j])%P
    M[j][i],M[j][j]=b0[i]*rev(B)%P,b0[j]*rev(B)%P
    Mi[j][i],Mi[j][j]=-b0[i]*rev(b0[j])%P,B*rev(b0[j])%P
assert mul(M,Mi)==[vec(15,i) for i in range(15)]
bb=lin(b0,Mi);cg=c0+[1];Ar=mul(mul(M,A0),Mi);Ar=[pad(r,16) for r in Ar+[bb]]
m=28;b=pad(bb,m);A=[pad(r,m) for r in Ar];c=cg[:];unit=lambda i:vec(m,i)
e0,e1=unit(0),unit(15)
from math import factorial
def echelon(A):
 a=[r[:] for r in A]; d=0; inds=[]
 for i in range(len(a[0])):
  k=next((k for k in range(d,len(a)) if a[k][i]%P),None)
  if k is None:continue
  a[d],a[k]=a[k],a[d];iv=rev(a[d][i]);a[d]=[x*iv%P for x in a[d]]
  for j in range(len(a)):
   if j!=d:
    q=a[j][i];a[j]=[(x-q*y)%P for x,y in zip(a[j],a[d])]
  d+=1;inds.append(i)
  if d==len(a):break
 return a,inds
def ker(rows):
 a,pc=echelon(rows); ans=[]
 for j in range(len(a[0])):
  if j not in pc:
   col=vec(len(a[0]),j)
   for t,k in enumerate(pc):col[k]=(-a[t][j])%P
   ans.append(col)
 return ans
def solve_rows(rows,vals):
 n=len(vals)
 rr=[r[:n] for r in rows]
 T=[list(x)+[b] for x,b in zip(zip(*rr),vals)]; rr,piv=echelon(T); assert len(rows) not in piv,(len(rows),piv)
 zz=[0]*len(rows)
 for t,j in enumerate(piv):zz[j]=rr[t][-1]
 assert lin(zz,[r[:n] for r in rows])==[x%P for x in vals]
 return zz
N=13;power=lambda s,k:pow(s,k,P)
E=lambda s:[power(s,k) for k in range(N)]
H=lambda s,l:[power(s,k+l+1)*factorial(k)*rev(factorial(k+l+1))%P for k in range(N)]
def shift(F):return [F[k+1]*rev(k+1)%P for k in range(len(F)-1)]
def times(F,s):return [(F[k+1]-s*F[k])%P for k in range(len(F)-1)]
def W(g):
 return [(E(0),e0),(E(1),e1)]+[([rev(j+t+1) for j in range(N)],[b[i]*pow(cg[i],t,P)%P if i<16 else 0 for i in range(m)]) for t in range(11-g)]
def rep(B,F,n):
 ts=solve_rows([x for x,y in B],F[:n]);return lin(ts,[y for x,y in B])
def do(F,s,B,g):
 assert all((s-z)%P for z in c)
 j=rep(B,shift(F),g);w=rep(B,times(F,s),g)
 r=[w[i]*rev(s-z)%P for i,z in enumerate(c)]
 gm=(F[0]+sum(r))%P
 row=lin([1]+r,[j]+A);row=[x*rev(gm)%P for x in row]
 c.append(s);A.append(row);obs=[(gm*t-u)%P for t,u in zip(unit(len(c)-1),pad(r,m))]
 assert sum(row)%P==s%P
 print('lift',len(c),'s',s,'gamma',gm)
 return F,obs
def local(o,s):
 A.append(o[1]);c.append(s);assert sum(A[-1])%P==s%P
 return E(s),unit(len(c)-1)
h=3*rev(8)%P
co=[H(h,l) for l in range(5)];q,=ker([x[:7] for x,_ in W(7)])
val=lambda x:dot(q,x[:7])
a=(-val(co[2])*rev(val(co[3])))%P;F=lin([1,a],[co[1],co[2]]);s=(h+val(co[2])*rev(val(F)))%P
H17=do(F,s,W(7),7)
H18=do(co[2],2,W(7)+[H17],7)
B8=W(8)+[H17,H18]
H19=do(co[1],3,B8,8)
H20=do(co[0],h,W(9)+[H19],9)
H21=local(H20,h)
B8+= [H19,H20,H21]; B9=W(9)+[H19,H20,H21];B10=W(10)+[H20,H21]
print('base ranks at 21',*[len(echelon([x[:k] for x,y in B])[1]) for B,k in [(B8,8),(B9,9),(B10,10)]])
v=4*rev(9)%P
H22=do(H(v,1),4,B8,8)
H23=do(H(v,0),v,B9+[H22],9)
H24=local(H23,v)
B9 += [H22,H23,H24];B10 += [H23,H24]
print('ranks at 24',*[len(echelon([x[:k] for x,y in B])[1]) for B,k in [(B9,9),(B10,10)]])
checks=[(7+1,H17),(7+1,H18),(8+1,H19),(9+1,H20),(10+1,H21),(8+1,H22),(9+1,H23),(10+1,H24)]
T=[];D=[];baseD=[];finalD=[];ranks={}
for n in range(1,12):
 layer=[]
 def go(k,start,u,f):
  if not k:
   v=[dot(r,u) for r in A]; fac=rev(f)
   for g,(F,ob) in checks:
    if n<=g:assert dot(ob,u)==F[n-1]*fac%P
   for j in [15,20,23]:
    if n<=10:assert v[j]==pow(c[j],n,P)*rev(n*f)%P
   q=[(ui-t*fac)%P for ui,t in zip(u,[pow(z,n-1,P) for z in c])]
   D.append(q)
   layer.append((n,v,n*f%P));return
  for j in range(start,len(T)):
   a,z,d=T[j]
   if a>k:break
   go(k-a,j,[x*y%P for x,y in zip(u,z)],f*d%P)
 go(n-1,0,[1]*len(c),1);T.extend(layer)
 if n>=8:
  ranks[n]=[(s,len(echelon([d[:s] for d in D])[1])) for s in [16,17,18,19,20,21,22,23,24]]
print('tree count',len(T),'defect ranks',ranks)
